verdict.rationale: Calendly's docs describe this core flow directly. You connect multiple calendars so conflicts are checked before anyone books (calendly-docs-15, calendly-docs-49), share a personalized scheduling link from your website, LinkedIn or email without manual coordination (calendly-docs-20, calendly-docs-41), and invitees pick from your available times. Community users independently confirm that invitees just pick a slot and only that slot gets blocked, ending repeated availability emails (calendly-comm-2, calendly-comm-3, calendly-comm-6). missing for 10: no hands-on evidence of how fast live availability updates propagate to the link (minor), plus a community complaint that there is no manual-confirmation option before a booking is accepted.
